title_en: Machine learning: business question and baseline, split and leakage, model families, honest evaluation (part 1 of 2)
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: هنفكك التسلسل الهرمي لعالم الذكاء الاصطناعي ونفهم إيه اللي بيفصل بين المصطلحات اللي بنسمعها كل يوم دي
sentences.en: We will unpack the hierarchy of the AI world and understand what separates the terms we hear every day.

sentences.ar: الـ AI أو الذكاء الاصطناعي هو المظلة الكبيرة بتاعتنا جواه
sentences.en: AI, or artificial intelligence, is our big umbrella; inside it we find...

sentences.ar: بنلاقي الـmachine learning وجوا الـmachine learning بنلاقي deep learning
sentences.en: Inside it we find machine learning, and inside machine learning we find deep learning.

sentences.ar: الفكرة هنا مش مجرد مسميات أو رص كلام الفكرة في طريقة الشغل نفسها وزاي الآلة بتفكر وبتتعلم
sentences.en: The point here isn't just labels or filler talk; it's about how the work itself is done and how a machine thinks and learns.

sentences.ar: الـmachine learning فعلا بيغير اللعبة تماما
sentences.en: Machine learning really changes the game completely.

sentences.ar: بدل ما نقعد نكتب قواعد برمجية صلبة بأيدينا أو اللي بنسميها hard-coded rules بنخلي النموذج يتعلم الـpattern لوحده من الأمثلة
sentences.en: Instead of sitting and hand-writing rigid code rules, the hard-coded rules, we let the model learn the pattern on its own from examples.

sentences.ar: المدخلات اللي بياخدها دي بنسميها features والإجابة أو النتيجة اللي بيطلعها بنسميها label
sentences.en: The inputs it takes we call features, and the answer or output it produces we call the label.

sentences.ar: وهنا بقى الشغل بيتقسم لنوعين
sentences.en: And here the work splits into two types.

sentences.ar: supervised لو عندنا الـlabel ده جاهز وعارفينه
sentences.en: Supervised, if we have the label ready and known.

sentences.ar: و unsupervised لو مفيش إجابة واضحة والنموذج محتاج يكتشف النمط ده بنفسه
sentences.en: And unsupervised, if there is no clear answer and the model needs to discover this pattern by itself.

sentences.ar: الرقم ده هو نقطة البداية بتاعتنا
sentences.en: This number is our starting point.

sentences.ar: لازم أي نموذج ذكي نبني يتفوق على الرقم ده
sentences.en: Any smart model we build has to beat this number.

sentences.ar: وإلا يبقى بنضيع وقتنا وما فيش داعي للتعقيد أصلا
sentences.en: Otherwise we are wasting our time and there is no need for the complexity at all.

sentences.ar: لكن لما نستخدم نموذج بيعمل fit مظبوط بنشوف إزاي الخط بيبدأ يلف ويتحرك في مكانه الصحيح
sentences.en: But when we use a model that does a proper fit, we see the line start to rotate and move to its right place.

sentences.ar: عشان يقلل المسافة بينه وبين النقط دي على قد ما يقدر وبالتالي يقلل الـloss أو نسبة الخسارة بشكل ملحوظ جدا
sentences.en: To cut the distance between it and these points as much as it can, and thereby cut the loss, the error, significantly.

sentences.ar: النتيجة بقى انخفاض درامي في نسبة الخطأ
sentences.en: The result is a dramatic drop in the error rate.

sentences.ar: الرقم هنا نزل لتستد MAE بيساوي 7.33 من مية
sentences.en: The number here fell to an MAE of 7.33 out of a hundred, only.

sentences.ar: بس خدوا بالكو الأهم من الرقم المبهر ده هو أنه اتسجل على داتا محجوزة أو اللي بنسميها held-out data
sentences.en: But watch out: more important than this impressive number is that it was recorded on held-out data, what we call held out data.

sentences.ar: دي بقى القاعدة الذهبية في المجال ده
sentences.en: This is the golden rule in this field.

sentences.ar: النماذج لازم تتقيم على داتا عمرها ما شافتها قبل كده
sentences.en: Models must be evaluated on data they have never seen before.

sentences.ar: لما نشوف أرقام وscores مبهرة ومثالية لدرجة خد أنهي واحد فيهم حيقدر يكمل ويعيش فعلاً في بيئة الـproduction الحقيقية
sentences.en: When we see numbers and scores this impressive and perfect, which one of them can actually carry on and live in the real production environment?

sentences.ar: الحقيقة الصادمة أن النماذج كتير جداً بيبقى شكلها مثالي على الورق بس بتفشل تماماً أول ما تنزل على أرض الواقعة
sentences.en: The shocking truth is that very many models look perfect on paper but fail completely as soon as they hit the ground.

sentences.ar: والسبب وراء ده هو اللي حنكشفه حالاً
sentences.en: And the reason behind this is what we will uncover right now.

sentences.ar: التسريب ده بينصب 3 فخاخ أساسية
sentences.en: This leakage sets 3 basic traps.

sentences.ar: أول فخ هو الـfuture column يعني ببساطة استخدام عمود بيانات ما كانش هيبقى متاح أصلاً وقت التنبؤ الحي
sentences.en: The first trap is the future column, simply meaning using a data column that would not even be available at prediction time.

sentences.ar: وثالث فخ هو الـgroup leak وده بيحصل لما نفصل البيانات بشكل يخلي النموذج يحفظ المجموعات بدل ما يتعلم النمط الحي اللي احنا عايزينه
sentences.en: And the third trap is group leak, which happens when we split the data in a way that makes the model memorize the groups instead of learning the pattern we want.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

referenced.ctx: The fitted line beats the baseline 7.33 vs 65.50 MAE on held-out data.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

first_mention_gloss.gloss_ar: إن معلومة من المستقبل دخلت التدريب

glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: Building models that learn patterns from data to make predictions, instead of following h…
concepts.failure: Evaluating a model on the same data it trained on, hiding overfitting and leakage.

concepts.def_en: In supervised machine learning, the known correct answer or output for each example that the model learns to predict.
concepts.def_ar: في الـsupervised learning، الـlabel هو الإجابة الصح المعروفة لكل مثال، واللي الموديل بيتعلم يتوقعها.
concepts.failure: Letting the label, or a column derived from it, leak into the features.

concepts.def_en: Learning from examples that already have the correct answer (label), so the model learns to predict that answer for new data.
concepts.def_ar: الـsupervised learning يعني نتعلّم من أمثلة فيها الإجابة الصح (الـlabel) متعروفة، عشان الـmodel يتنبأ بيها للداتا الجديدة.
concepts.failure: Assuming supervised learning works without enough trustworthy labels; wrong labels teach wrong answers.

concepts.def_en: Learning from data with no given answer; the model discovers structure by itself, such as clusters or unusual points.
concepts.def_ar: الـunsupervised learning يعني نتعلّم من داتا من غير إجابة جاهزة؛ الـmodel بيكتشف النمط لوحده، زي المجموعات أو النقط الغريبة.
concepts.failure: Expecting one correct answer to check against; clusters need judgement, not accuracy.

concepts.def_en: A number measuring how wrong a model's prediction is; training adjusts weights to make it…
concepts.failure: Judging a model by training loss alone; it keeps falling while test error rises.

concepts.def_en: Mean absolute error: the average of the absolute differences between predictions and actual values, in the same units as the target.
concepts.def_ar: الـMAE (mean absolute error) هو متوسط الفرق المطلق بين التوقع والقيمة الفعلية، وبنفس وحدة الـlabel.
concepts.failure: Reading the MAE number without comparing it to a naive baseline's error.

concepts.def_en: The live environment where real users and real data are served, so changes there carry re…
concepts.failure: Testing or editing directly in production, risking accidental data changes and outages.

concepts.def_en: Information from the answer or the future sneaking into training, so test scores look exc…
concepts.failure: Fitting scalers or encoders on all data before splitting, leaking test information into t…

concepts.def_en: One named attribute of a table with a fixed data type shared by every row.
concepts.failure: Storing several values in one column, which breaks first normal form.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
Bars (single or stacked) with token colours; values carry refs.
A deck dealt into train/validation/test splits (seeded).
A threshold handle on a scale; zones flip state as it moves.
Deep-Dive entry card with parent chapter and prerequisite concepts.
